name: runx
description: Search and inspect Runx skills through its public hosted MCP. Governed execution runs in the separate local runtime.

interface.longDescription: Search the public Runx skill catalog and inspect what a skill does, needs and permits. Governed execution happens in the separately installed Apache-2.0 Runx runtime, with explicit authority and signed receipts.
defaultPrompt: Find Runx skills for reviewing a pull request.
Inspect the requirements and license of a Runx skill before I use it.
Find a skill for a bounded research task and tell me what authority it needs.
